method: One process_data worker at a time; local inputs and published dependencies; no publication; photo moves simulated.
limitations: Interrupted measurements are lower bounds, not complete producer peaks.
Separate RSS/swap peaks are not necessarily simultaneous.
RSS includes reclaimable allocator pages, mapped files and shared libraries; it is not active working memory.
disk_final and disk_ssd_final samples sum worker and live descendants; shared pages can be counted twice in aggregate RSS.
address_final additionally samples PSS and LazyFree; PSS apportions shared pages but still includes reclaimable pages and is not active working memory. Separate metric peaks need not coincide.

Earlier DataFusion sorts silently lost the chosen spill directory after SQL runtime changes and used /tmp (tmpfs); their RSS excludes that tmpfs consumption. disk_final fixes this with a child-only TMPDIR.
Fresh workers do not reproduce allocator retention across producers in the normal single-process runner.
No controlled cold/warm cache or latency comparison; scratch disks vary between runs.
SDS inputs were staged from local cached JSON using the Downloader conversion; zero-byte CEAP input remains untouched.
Published output/checkpoint preservation is checked by size and mtime, not a full byte hash.
Complete before/after footer counts and schemas are compared; complete real row values are not compared against interrupted baselines.

allocator_observation.scope: one establishments sort sample; not an active-memory peak

tests.scope: Turi fixtures and offline smoke tests
